facts.fact: The Mzalendo tracker links the Kenya Digital Master Plan from the ICT Authority site as a public text titled 2022-2032, and says it encompasses environmental protection and conservation; the date used is the tracker's published date, 2026-05-11, as the page gives no event date.
The tracker links the plan's text on the ICT Authority's site.
